implementation_summary: Additive A2UI history persistence mirroring the legacy interactive_request path. GeneratedMessage gains a2ui_envelopes (assistant turn, raw versioned envelopes) and a2ui_action + a2ui_data_model (user turn) with explicit wire aliases a2uiEnvelopes/a2uiAction/a2uiDataModel (pydantic to_camel would emit a2Ui*). ChatTurnData and ChatHistoryData carry the same fields; _serve_data accumulates the ordered list of {"a2ui": ...} chunk envelopes (2-3 per surface) and hands it to save_chat_history -> upsert_chat_history -> update_chat_history. New module service/conversation/a2ui_intake.py provides materialize_a2ui_request_text ("[Interactive surface <id> shown to the user]" + compact updateComponents JSON) and materialize_a2ui_action_text (display + "[Structured response to surface <id>]" + compact action+dataModel JSON); Conversation.to_chat_history uses them via lazy imports, preferring A2UI fields over legacy interactive ones per message. Request-side a2ui_action/a2ui_data_model read via getattr until the T-BE2 intake task lands. ConversationResponse.history round-trips the new fields through List[GeneratedMessage].
